content:
allhands_host: Live thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands. Short, tactical Qs about mission/positioning welcome. Tag if you want a deeper doc.
ceo_karina: TL;DR: mission unchanged but we need clearer buyer narratives. Ask rapid-fire and leadership will respond.
growth_lee: Quick: which buyer gets the new "first sale" playbook? small AI startups or platform teams at larger SaaS orgs?
sales_rachel: Startups drive velocity and referrals. Platform teams bring bigger contracts but longer cycles. We should prioritize beachhead wins w/ startups while mapping enterprise hooks.
product_aly: For marketing decks, what's the one-liner we want on the hero slide?
cto_matt: "Inference that behaves in production" — follow with bullets: predictable economics, rollout controls, and same API across environments. Keep it punchy.
eng_sam: Ops question: do we promise the same latency SLAs across Hosted and Dedicated?
cto_matt: Not identical. Hosted offers best-effort with clear SLOs; Dedicated has SLA-backed latency tiers. We'll be explicit in docs to avoid surprises.
finance_jordan: What's the conversion KPI to watch? Hosted active devs -> Dedicated commitments?
allhands_host: We'll track Hosted->Reserved conversion rate and payback period; finance will publish targets.
product_aly: Competitive callout: how do we stop "just use cloud X" from winning deals?
sales_rachel: Playbook: lead with predictable unit economics and our migration story. Then show how our rollout/observability reduces ops risk. Short demo helps.
allhands_bot: Pulse poll started: 1) Prioritize Startups 2) Dual-track 3) Enterprise-first. Voting 48h.
ceo_karina: We'll produce a one-page buyer playbook and an objection guide by next Tuesday. If you want in the working group, react :raised_hands:.
allhands_host: Thanks all 1 minute answers. We'll post the collateral and KPI dashboard link in the recap. Thread locked for live replies.
